alternatives.limit: No mutable query state, online adaptation, stochastic inference, external packages in inference, data-dependent loops or unbounded graphs. Only methods expressible by declared primitives/caps are eligible; not unrestricted frontier-method search.
alternatives.method_family: Arbitrary training algorithms may export bounded deterministic acyclic arithmetic predictors; native reproduction remains unrestricted executable program output.
alternatives.question: How much first-odor information is available in each current local delay representation, beyond simultaneous movement/licking and timing priors?
alternatives.strength: Separates local representational information from memory carried by a predictor from early cue/delay. Strong local CNN/MLP/RBF/tree/attention models can be expressed.
alternatives.support: Five disjoint15-frame windows cover the full source common-delay frame interval95:169 inclusive, one-based. All5windows/all140trials/all44sessions/bothvariants retained. This is a prospective fixed discretization, not exact historical0.5s-bin reconstruction.

alternatives.limit: Cannot locate information at later delay bins or infer persistence from later predictions; early-delay evidence can suffice. Does not answer the recommended current-representation question.
alternatives.method_family: Arbitrary predictor executable in an isolated per-fold inference job; it may integrate all75frames but sees no other query trials or query labels. Fresh state per trial required.
alternatives.question: How well can the entire common-delay population trajectory classify remembered first odor beyond whole-delay nuisance trajectories?
alternatives.strength: Allows general temporal/recurrent/dynamical methods without arithmetic-graph export restriction and directly tests trajectory-level information.
alternatives.support: All75frames95:169 supplied together for every held trial, with the same cohorts, two variants and trial folds.

exact_set_definition.candidate_policy: Only outer training support T_k is exposed. Candidate internal optimization/tuning may be arbitrary there; no claim that opaque candidate code follows the independent comparator inner schedule.
exact_set_definition.indexing: zero-based trial indices; U={0,...,139}; B_k={20k,...,20k+19}, k=0,...,6
exact_set_definition.inner: For each l!=k: V_kl=T_k intersect B_l; S_kl=T_k minus (B_l union N(B_l)). V_kl sets partition T_k. All windows of a trial stay together.
exact_set_definition.neighbors: N(B_k)=({20k-1,20k+20} intersect U), individual adjacent trials, never neighboring chunks
exact_set_definition.reference_policy: The trusted comparator uses exactly all six S_kl/V_kl fits per configuration, with preprocessing fitted on S_kl only. No failed or class-missing fold is silently omitted.

folds.inner: Use exact S_kl and V_kl sets below; these exclude adjacent trial indices, not entire neighboring chunks. Pool all complete inner OOF predictions for model/threshold selection.
folds.purge: Remove exactly the trial-index neighbor set N(B) defined below. This prospective one-trial purge is not a certificate that upstream Suite2P, source normalization or raw temporal overlap is eliminated.
folds.unit: Mouse is independent aggregation/uncertainty unit;44sessions and repeatedneurons/5windows/2variants are not additional animals. Heldtrial/chunk is not heldanimal transfer.

matched_null_policy.atoms: For each outer T_k, partition its trials by original acquisition chunk and the complete vector of membership indicators in every S_kl and V_kl. Trials with identical vectors form one atom.
matched_null_policy.closure_proof: Every S_kl and V_kl is a union of atoms. Any within-atom permutation maps each such support to itself, so labels from excluded inner validation/purge trials cannot enter an inner fit. No outer-query target enters an atom.
matched_null_policy.limitations: Class counts are preserved within each atom and every enforced support. Singleton atoms and fixed label assignments remain disclosed; this is a conditional randomization diagnostic, not a claim that all task priors or odor-label information are destroyed. Record atom sizes, permutation, unchanged-label counts and support before fitting; no favorable reseeding.
matched_null_policy.name: Within-eligibility-atom training-label permutation; prospective conditional shuffle null, not total destruction of every label association.
matched_null_policy.native_shuffle: Original MATLAB shuffle rules and RNG remain untouched and separate.
matched_null_policy.permutation: Use a fixed protocol-seeded permutation within each atom, derived only from case/source/split identities and atom member indices, with no outcome-selected seed. Apply once to the original outer training target vector. All roles use the identical resulting outer-null labels.
matched_null_policy.validation: The trusted reference fits on null labels restricted to S_kl and selects/calibrates on null labels restricted to V_kl. It does not use original inner-validation labels. Final refit uses null labels on all T_k. Candidate receives only null labels on T_k and may tune arbitrarily within that admitted view.

feature_layout.all_missing_query: Retain the query and all masks/support. Apply the same training transform; do not drop it or use query means. Entirely absent required fields/clocks and +/-infinity are admission failures, not imputed observations.
feature_layout.candidate_transform: Candidate training may choose other transforms within identical outer training/eligible ROI/temporal support. The above is the independently fixed comparator layout, not a claim to police opaque candidate internal tuning.
feature_layout.channel_order: Eligible neural ROI order first when permitted; then locomotion and lick-count channels when permitted. Nuisance and combined include the5 current-window one-hot clock entries last; neural-only includes no explicit clock.
feature_layout.fullwindow: Flatten permitted channels in channel-major order,15 chronological samples per channel; append one corresponding missing indicator per continuous coordinate, then permitted5 clock entries.
feature_layout.gamma_dimension: D is the complete post-transform feature-vector length, including retained continuous positions, missing-indicator positions and allowed clock entries. Never remove zero-variance/all-missing features to change D. Gaussian gamma is multiplier/D.
feature_layout.mean: One mean per permitted channel over its15 samples; a feature is missing if any required sample is nonfinite. Continuous features in channel order, then corresponding missing indicators, then permitted5 clock entries.
feature_layout.training_transform: For each continuous feature, compute mean and population standard deviation from finite values in that fit training support only. Missing values are replaced by that training mean and standardize to0. Zero variance uses scale1. All-missing training features use mean0/scale1 and continuous coordinate0 for every later view; retain their positions and actual missing indicators. Missing indicators remain0/1 and clock entries remain one-hot, with no fitted scaling.

reference_training.kernel_definition: Gaussian exp(-gamma*max(0, squaredEuclideandistance)); explicit customnativefunction avoids implicit KernelScale convention. Exporttyped constants/supportvectors/coefficients; verifyexport graph against trustednativepredict on training only. UnknownnativeAPI or failedroundtrip makes referenceincomplete, neverchooses a query-agreeing formula.
reference_training.selection: Complete innerOOF paired-class balancedaccuracy with trainingonly thresholdcalibration. Selectbestcompletevalid config; deterministictiespreferlowercomplexity thenlowerC thendeclaredkernelorder. Allattempts/failures retained; no queryscoring duringselection.
reference_training.shuffle: Use the common outer atom-preserving permutation defined in matched_null_policy. Inner fitting and validation both use restrictions of the same permuted labels, never original validation labels. The candidate shuffled-family producer receives only this same outer-permuted vector. All original outer-query labels remain private.
